tool_description: DermReg performs pair-wise registration of a pair of two dermoscopic follow-up images using AKAZE key-points and a RANSAC-estimated homography. It outputs the aligned (warped) follow-up image together with the transformation matrix.
demo_commands:
docker run --rm --gpus all 
  -v /home/pathto/SDDI:/data 
  derm_reg 
  python Akaze_alignment.py /data/imagesTs/ISIC_0133200.jpg /data/imagesTs/ISIC_1435135.jpg -o out_dir --artifacts_removal

docker run --rm --gpus all 
  -v /home/pathto/SDDI:/data 
  derm_reg 
  python Akaze_alignment.py /data/imagesTs/ISIC_0133200.jpg /data/imagesTs/ISIC_1435135.jpg -o out_dir

baseline_image.description: Absolute path to the baseline (earlier) dermoscopic image.

followup_image.description: Absolute path to the follow-up dermoscopic image.

output_dir.description: Directory where the aligned image and transformation file will be saved.

artifacts_removal.description: If true, applies illumination / artifact removal before registration.

aligned_image_png.description: Path to the warped follow-up image aligned to the baseline.

transform_txt.description: Path to a TXT file storing the 3 × 3 homography matrix.
